course.title: Statistics for Planners-II
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A statistics teacher of URP Batch 2k17 wants to compare the final examination mark for course URP-2191 (Statistics for Planner-I) and URP-2291 (Statistics for Planners-Il) for a class of 60. Course URP-2191 has an average score of 70 and standard deviation of 17. Course URP-2291 has an average score of 65 and standard deviation of 12. Using α=0.05, have the students performed differently between the two courses? Perform appropriate test following standard statistical procedure.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
